setting.help: Several changes asked at once (a customer, the quotation with its lines, then sending it) are shown first as one card with numbered steps: the person takes a step out or corrects a value, says yes once, then each change still shows its own card. A single change has no plan. A step that fails stops the plan and says what was done and what was not, with Undo for what was done; after each change, Nudge reads the records again and says so when a field did not end as asked.
